name: Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pan and soften the diced onion.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through with no pink remaining.
Season the beef with cumin, chilli, and salt and simmer for a few minutes.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with the beef, then top with diced tomato, shredded lettuce, and cheese.
